about: Search regression set for Strang, Introduction to Linear Algebra, 5th edition (2016). The book is not in the repository. Run: npm run bench:ingest -- "<path to the book's PDF>" --queries tests/bench/strang-regression.json. Pages are 1-based PDF pages; each check needs the first result's matching sentences on that page (or inside the range) and, where given, in that section.
